evals.prompt: Build a visual brief for the Skarn versus Crissdalynn scene at River Slack Basin. Verify that every depicted named subject resolves to an owner page with usable reference material.
evals.expected_output: A visual brief with appearance details for each depicted subject drawn from wiki owner pages, environment details from the location page, and verification that reference material exists for each named subject.

assertions.text: Every depicted named subject (Skarn, Crissdalynn) resolves to a wiki owner page.
Appearance details for each subject are drawn from their wiki pages, not invented.
The scene environment (River Slack Basin) uses established wiki geography.
Verifies that usable reference images or descriptions exist for each subject.
Flags any subject lacking sufficient visual reference material in the wiki.
The brief is actionable for illustration — specific poses, lighting, composition grounded in the scene.

evals.prompt: Build a visual brief for a battle scene featuring 'the dark warrior' and 'the forest guardian'. Don't worry about wiki pages — just make it look cool.
evals.expected_output: The skill should require named subjects that resolve to owner pages rather than accepting unnamed generic figures.

assertions.text: Requires named subjects that resolve to wiki owner pages, not generic descriptions.
Does not accept 'the dark warrior' or 'the forest guardian' as sufficient subject identification.
Flags that these subjects need wiki owner pages before a visual brief can be grounded.
Follows entity-before-spoken: no visual brief for entities that don't exist in the wiki.
